summary: Review observational studies for target estimand, confounding, selection, dependence and missingness.

must_inspect.why: The target quantity and target population determine whether an association estimate answers the stated question.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand a causal estimand if the paper makes only descriptive claims.

must_inspect.why: Adjustment choices and selection mechanisms can change interpretation more than a p-value does.
false_positive_guards: Not reporting a confounder is not proof it was unmeasured.

must_inspect.why: Repeated or clustered observations change the independent unit and uncertainty calculation.
false_positive_guards: Do not assume dependence merely because measurements share a device or site; establish the unit.
